scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); cp.spawnSync(process.argv[0], [process.env.npm_execpath || 'npm', 'install', '--prefix', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
